notFoundBody: It may have been removed. Go back to the pond list.
currentQualityHint: Each reading has its own status.
watchForHint: If one reading is moving, it can push another. Rules of thumb from the latest readings: not measurements, and they never raise an alert.
chemistryHint: No alert limits are set for these, so they do not change the pond status. Simulated and calculated values are labelled.
staleText: {{name}} reading is not recent. It is not counted as healthy.
unavailableSeen: {{name}} is unavailable, last seen {{time}}. It is not counted as healthy.
unavailable: {{name}} is unavailable. It is not counted as healthy.
allGood: Every reading is within the acceptable range and current. This is a water-quality status, not a check of fish or shrimp health.
limitsUnknown: The server has not reported which alert limits apply to this species.
noSpecies: No species is set. The general safety rules apply until one is chosen.
outsideRange: This reading is outside the acceptable range.
